title: Primary Air Fan
model_title: Primary Air (PA) Fan — High Pressure, IGV & Outlet Damper

introduction.definition: A primary air (PA) fan supplies high-pressure air to coal pulverisers (mills): it dries the coal and carries the pulverised fuel to the burners. It needs much higher pressure than an FD fan at lower flow, hence a narrow high-speed impeller, with inlet vanes for control and an outlet damper for isolation.
key_points: Mill air flow and temperature control fuel transport
Outlet damper isolates a fan in parallel operation

classification.type: Centrifugal, narrow high-pressure impeller, IGV + outlet damper

foundation: Mount on a rigid, level foundation or grouted baseplate sized for the machine mass and dynamic loads (typically ≥3–5 × machine mass for reciprocating machines).
Check for soft foot before final bolting.
alignment: Align driver and driven shafts with a laser or dial-indicator method to the coupling maker's tolerances; re-check hot alignment where thermal growth is significant.
piping: Provide good inlet conditions: straight duct or bellmouth; avoid elbows close to the inlet (system effect).
Fit flexible connections at inlet and outlet.
commissioning: Check rotation direction with the coupling disconnected.
Fill lubricant to the correct level and grade.
Start unloaded where possible; record vibration, temperatures, current and pressures as a baseline.

video_tutorials.title: Primary Air Fan — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Primary Air Fan.
A primary air (PA) fan supplies high-pressure air to coal pulverisers (mills): it dries the coal and carries the pulverised fuel to the burners.
It needs much higher pressure than an FD fan at lower flow, hence a narrow high-speed impeller, with inlet vanes for control and an outlet damper for isolation.
Typical applications include pulverised-coal fired boilers; biomass and coal mill systems; fluidised bed boilers (fluidising air); high-pressure process air.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Scroll (Volute) Housing with Outlet, Impeller (16 backward-curved aerofoil blades), Hub & Shaft, Inlet Cone (Venturi).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Primary Air Fan — Operation

script.narration: How the Primary Air Fan works.
Air is drawn through the inlet cone into the eye of the impeller.
The spinning blades throw the air outward, adding velocity and pressure.
Inlet guide vanes control the airflow.
The scroll builds the high pressure needed by the mills.
The outlet damper isolates or throttles the fan.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

video_tutorials.title: Primary Air Fan — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Primary Air Fan.
Check bearing temperature and vibration.
Check damper seals and actuator.
Clean impeller and housing; check inlet cone gap.
Check coupling alignment.
Inspect impeller for erosion/cracks; re-balance.
Replace bearings.
Watch for vibration from imbalance: rising 1× running-speed vibration. Common cause: dust build-up or erosion on blades.
Watch for bearing overheating: high bearing temperature. Common cause: lack/excess of grease, misalignment.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
